comments.content: I think we should start putting together a more formal marketing plan in the form of GitHub issues. I fear that because I have so many things on my plate now I will forget about this. Would you be able to start with a meta issue in this repository? We can make a dedicated repository later.

Stumbled upon https://www.chaingpt.org/ and I think their growth strategy is insane. I am highly, highly skeptical about their technology but looking at the way the company and the founder presents himself is top notch for a new startup. 
What really put me over the edge for being impressed was the "as seen on" section on their homepage. They have linked proof of real tweets and press releases from respected names about their project. 
I think we should study them. 
### Deliverable
Outline everything they did from launch to now. Make a plan and then we can replicate it in the form of GitHub tasks under a new repo.
This overview is nice but is not ready because it lacks the second half of the prompt:
It seems like a lot of this is bottlenecked by me reviewing. Instead this task was intended for the researcher to provide proposals. I would review the proposals, not the raw research.

Well I think that we spent a fair amount of time developing the fundamentals of our business. Now we can embellish the truth and "sell the dream" which is common in sales and marketing.
Think of something like WeWork. They had a real business (albeit not profitable as far as I recall) but Adam Neumann made the idea of coworking spaces sound like something a lot more exciting than office spaces.
They were valued at over a billion dollars for some office space rentals lol
